verdict.rationale: Thoropass is a compliance automation platform, so built-in security awareness training is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never mentions training modules, assigning training on hire, or tracking training completion. The closest items are policy create/review/acknowledge automation and admin Onboarding Mode, which are adjacent features, not security awareness training.

support.subject: As an operations lead, security awareness training is built in — assigned on hire, tracked to completion, and accepted as audit evidence
